descriptions: Fixed dependent resources (HUD, phone, job scripts) never initialising on Qbox because the core does not emit its player-loaded event when login is driven by an external character selector, so the resource now emits it when the core stays silent
Fixed the was not safe for net console spam by emitting the client player-loaded event locally instead of over the network
Fixed character deletion silently failing on Qbox because the cleanup aborted on the qb-core only tables player_houses and player_contacts
Fixed the character list refusing to load when the playerskins table is not present on the server
